reference.title: HTTP connection counts
reference.shortdesc: Use worker connection count environment variables to limit simultaneous HTTP connections per Red Hat Quay worker process globally or per component. These limits apply either globally or can be scoped to individual components (registry, web UI, or security scanning). By default, each worker process allows up to 50 parallel connections.

section.p: This setting is distinct from the number of worker processes.
These connection-related environment variables can be configured differently depending on your deployment type:

ul.li: In standalone deployments, configure connection counts in the config.yaml file.
In Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform deployments, define the values in the env block of the QuayRegistry CR.

entry.p: Global default for the maximum number of HTTP connections per worker process.
